Members

varint

Encodes a varint (tag field for int64/enum fields).

tag

Field header — fieldNumber << 3 | wireType.

bytes

Length-delimited field (strings, bytes, messages, packed numerics).

Varint field (int64/enum/int32).

str

UTF-8 string field.

Packed repeated int64 field (dims, pads, kernel_shape…).

rawF32

Little-endian float32 payload — TensorProto.raw_data.

dim

TensorShapeProto.Dim — fixed int64 dim or symbolic (dim_param).

shape

TensorShapeProto from an array of dim specs.

tensorType

TypeProto.Tensor — elem_type FLOAT(1) + shape.

valueInfo

ValueInfoProto — input/output declaration.

tensor

TensorProto initializer — float32 weights stored as raw_data.

attrInt

AttributeProto — INT / INTS / STRING kinds only.

node

NodeProto — op_type + input/output name lists + optional attrs.

opset

OperatorSetIdProto — default domain, opset 13 (DepthToSpace CRD era).

graph

GraphProto — nodes, initializers, value infos, name.

model

ModelProto — ir_version 8 + producer + graph + opset import.

intentModel

intent.onnx — navigation-intent scorer. Input [1,3] [hoverNorm, speedNorm, bias]; sigmoid(w·x) → P(navigate). Weights are the NPU-tier heuristic lifted into logit space: hover +2.2, speed −1.6, intercept −0.6 — a slow dwelt hover lands ≈0.83, a fast flyby ≈0.35.

frametimeModel

frametime.onnx — next-frame-time predictor for three.js adaptive quality. Input [1,6]: last 5 frame times normalized to 100ms plus the current quality level 0–1. One hidden relu layer computes a damped exponential average + quality uplift; output ≈ predicted frame ms/100.

cubicTaps

Catmull-Rom bicubic kernel weights for one 2× subpixel phase — the four taps of the cubic filter at the given fractional offset, exactly as a software bicubic resampler computes them.

  • @param off Fractional sample offset (−0.25 / +0.25 for 2× phases).
  • @returns Four filter taps for input rows {floor−1…floor+2}.

superresModel

superres-2x.onnx — a real Conv + DepthToSpace 2× upscaler. Conv(3→12, 4×4, pads [1,1,2,2]) produces 3 channels × 4 subpixel phases whose kernels are separable Catmull-Rom bicubic taps (outer product of the vertical and horizontal phase filters); DepthToSpace(mode=CRD) interleaves them into the 2× image. This is GPU/NPU-accelerated bicubic super-resolution — markedly sharper than canvas drawImage bilinear when only the low-quality source exists.

diagramModel

diagram-cost.onnx — mermaid render-cost scorer for the docs viewer. Input [1,4]: normalized [nodes, edges, nesting, selfMessages]; output is predicted raster+layout ms, used to decide whether the diagram renders immediately or defers to idle so large graphs never block docs interactivity. Linear model: cost ≈ 4·nodes + 6·edges + 10·nesting + 2·self + 3.

ORT_FILES

ORT binaries the webgpu bundle fetches from env.wasm.wasmPaths.

genOnnxModels

Writes every model under website/public/models/ and copies the ORT runtime binaries into website/public/ort/ (skipping files that are already identical). Returns the list of files written — callers log.

  • @returns Paths (repo-relative) of emitted/copied files.
